# Tags

Compact, non-interactive labels used to attach metadata, categorize content, or surface status. Tags come in five semantic variants plus an On-Color variant for dark surfaces, three sizes, and support filled and outlined styles, rounded (pill) shape, leading and trailing icon slots, and icon-only forms.

**Stylesheet:** `components/tags/tags.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for configuring tag components.

| Class | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.tag` | CSS class | Required | Base tag class. Must be applied to all tags. |
| `.tag--neutral` | CSS class | Default variant | Gray neutral variant. Applied implicitly when no other variant class is present. |
| `.tag--success` | CSS class | — | Green variant for positive or completed states. |
| `.tag--error` | CSS class | — | Red variant for errors or destructive states. |
| `.tag--warning` | CSS class | — | Yellow/amber variant for cautionary states. |
| `.tag--info` | CSS class | — | Blue variant for informational states. |
| `.tag--on-color` | CSS class | — | White-on-alpha variant for use on dark or colored backgrounds. |
| `.tag--md` | CSS class | — | Medium size (32px height, 16px / 24px text). |
| `.tag--sm` | CSS class | Default size | Small size (24px height, 12px / 18px text). Default when no size class is applied. |
| `.tag--xs` | CSS class | — | X-Small size (20px height, 10px / 14px semibold text). |
| `.tag--outline` | CSS class | — | Transparent fill with colored border. Combines with any variant. |
| `.tag--rounded` | CSS class | — | Pill shape with fully rounded corners. |
| `.tag--icon-only` | CSS class | — | Square tag containing only an icon (no label). |
| `.tag__icon` | CSS class | — | Icon slot. Use one before the label for a leading icon, one after for a trailing icon, or both. |

## Tag Variants

The five semantic variants. Neutral for default metadata, Success and Error for positive and negative states, Warning and Info for cautionary and informational signals. The On-Color variant is shown separately below.

```html
<span class="tag tag--neutral">Neutral</span>
<span class="tag tag--success">Success</span>
<span class="tag tag--error">Error</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning">Warning</span>
<span class="tag tag--info">Info</span>
```

## Tag Sizes

Three size options matching the Figma typography scale. Medium (32px, 16/24 medium), Small (24px, 12/18 medium — the default), and X-Small (20px, 10/14 semibold).

```html
<span class="tag tag--success tag--md">Medium (32px)</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--sm">Small (24px)</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--xs">X-Small (20px)</span>
```

## Outline Variants

Outlined style strips the fill, keeping only the border and label color. Use when a softer visual weight is needed, such as in dense lists or alongside other UI controls.

```html
<span class="tag tag--neutral tag--outline">Neutral</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--outline">Success</span>
<span class="tag tag--error tag--outline">Error</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning tag--outline">Warning</span>
<span class="tag tag--info tag--outline">Info</span>
```

## Rounded Variants

Pill-shaped tags use a fully rounded border-radius. Available across all variants and combinable with the outline modifier.

```html
<span class="tag tag--neutral tag--rounded">Neutral</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--rounded">Success</span>
<span class="tag tag--error tag--rounded">Error</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning tag--rounded">Warning</span>
<span class="tag tag--info tag--rounded">Info</span>



<span class="tag tag--neutral tag--rounded tag--outline">Neutral</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--rounded tag--outline">Success</span>
<span class="tag tag--error tag--rounded tag--outline">Error</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning tag--rounded tag--outline">Warning</span>
<span class="tag tag--info tag--rounded tag--outline">Info</span>
```

## Tags with Icon Font

Using the DGA icon font system instead of inline SVGs. Apply an icon font class directly to a span inside the .tag__icon slot, or use the icon font class on the slot itself.

```html
<span class="tag tag--success">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
    Verified
</span>
<span class="tag tag--error">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-cancel-circle"></span>
    Rejected
</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-alert-02"></span>
    Pending
</span>
<span class="tag tag--info">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-information-circle"></span>
    Note
</span>
<span class="tag tag--neutral">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
    Featured
</span>



<span class="tag tag--success tag--md">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
    Medium
</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--sm">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
    Small
</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--xs">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
    X-Small
</span>
```

## Icon-Only Tags

Square tags containing only an icon (no label). Useful for compact status indicators in tables and lists. Available across all three sizes and combinable with any variant or shape.

```html
<span class="tag tag--success tag--icon-only tag--md">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--icon-only tag--sm">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--icon-only tag--xs">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
</span>



<span class="tag tag--neutral tag--icon-only">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-tag-01"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--icon-only">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--error tag--icon-only">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-cancel-circle"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning tag--icon-only">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-alert-02"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--info tag--icon-only">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-information-circle"></span>
</span>



<span class="tag tag--success tag--icon-only tag--rounded">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--success tag--icon-only tag--rounded tag--outline">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--error tag--icon-only tag--outline">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-cancel-circle"></span>
</span>
```

## On-Color Variant

For use on dark or colored backgrounds. Uses white at 20% alpha for the fill, white at 60% alpha for the border, and pure white for the label and icon — matching the Figma tag-background-on-color and tag-border-on-color tokens.

```html
<span class="tag tag--on-color">On-Color</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--outline">Outline</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--rounded">Rounded</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--rounded tag--outline">Rounded + Outline</span>



<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--md">Medium</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--sm">Small</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--xs">X-Small</span>



<span class="tag tag--on-color">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
    Featured
</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--outline">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
    Verified
</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--icon-only">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
</span>
<span class="tag tag--on-color tag--icon-only tag--outline tag--rounded">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-information-circle"></span>
</span>
```

## RTL Support

Right-to-left layout support for Arabic and other RTL languages. Icon placement is automatically mirrored based on document direction.

```html
<span class="tag tag--success">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span>
    مكتمل
</span>
<span class="tag tag--error">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-cancel-circle"></span>
    مرفوض
</span>
<span class="tag tag--warning">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-alert-02"></span>
    قيد المراجعة
</span>
<span class="tag tag--info">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-information-circle"></span>
    ملاحظة
</span>
<span class="tag tag--neutral tag--rounded">
    <span class="tag__icon dga-icon-star"></span>
    مميز
</span>
```
